purpose: Public-safe per-row evidence ledger for Google-owned and owner-owned monetization checks. A row-level PASS means that specific evidence item passed; it does not mean full AdMob production monetization is ready unless the strict pass command passes.

items.evidence: 2026-08-25: public root app-ads check passed for https://yehor212.github.io/app-ads.txt with masked publisher pub-9501********2808.
items.ownerAction: Re-run the public root check after every deploy, publisher change, or developer website change.

items.evidence: ZenFlow app-ads.txt console page was reviewed, but AdMob showed no app-ads.txt request data yet, so crawler verification is not confirmed.
items.ownerAction: Owner must re-open the AdMob app verification/app-ads.txt area after crawler refresh and record only a public-safe PASS, PARTIAL, UNVERIFIED, or FAIL summary.

items.evidence: Eight localized full descriptions with explicit Habits banner-ad disclosure were submitted to Google Play review on 2026-08-25. The public listing has not published those reviewed changes yet, so the public runtime check remains UNVERIFIED.
items.ownerAction: Re-run the public listing check after every Google Play listing or policy declaration edit.

items.evidence: 2026-08-25: google-play:privacy:public-check and the GitHub Pages post-deploy public privacy smoke passed. Google Mobile Ads, UMP, Advertising ID, Habits banner, and Google Mobile Ads SDK data categories including IP address were present; stale rewarded and no-ads wording was absent.
items.ownerAction: Re-run the GitHub Pages post-deploy public privacy smoke and npm run google-play:privacy:public-check after every privacy policy, ads SDK, consent, developer website, or Google Play Data safety change.

items.evidence: ZenFlow Android app readiness is Ready, ad serving enabled, Google Play linked, and active ad units are present.
items.ownerAction: Re-check AdMob app readiness before each release, after policy/listing changes, and before claiming live ad availability.

items.evidence: AdMob Policy Center showed no violations and stated there are no blocking issues that can prevent or limit ad serving. Because the Policy Center covers policy, regulatory, and advertiser-preference issue types, this confirms no regulatory issues, no advertiser-preference restrictions, and no restricted or disabled ad requests are listed.
items.ownerAction: Owner must re-check AdMob Policy Center and record only public-safe PASS evidence covering no violations, no blocking issues, no regulatory issues, no advertiser-preference restrictions, and no restricted or disabled ad requests.

items.evidence: Published European regulations message uses the Google-certified CMP with TCF v2.3 and targets ZenFlow in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland. Google supported-language list reviewed. ZenFlow CMP languages en, uk, es, de, fr, and ja were all reviewed and available. Arabic (ar) and Hebrew (he) European regulations fallback was reviewed; no Arabic or Hebrew European regulations translation is claimed, so the default English message is used. Do not consent is enabled; close do-not-consent is reviewed and disabled. The privacy-options entry point and canRequestAds gate passed the fresh native UMP check.
items.ownerAction: Owner must create/publish the required AdMob Privacy & messages flow for ZenFlow's AdMob app, review Google-supported European regulations languages, document Arabic/Hebrew fallback, and then re-run this ledger before claiming full CMP readiness.

items.evidence: Payments tax status was intentionally not inspected because payout details are not required to prove ad serving and the page may expose private data.
items.ownerAction: Owner must check the relevant tax information page and record only whether no action is required, review is pending, or Google shows a blocking action.

items.evidence: Payments identity and address status was intentionally not inspected because the page may expose private identity data.
items.ownerAction: Owner must check Payments verification and record only a public-safe status without private identifiers or document details.

items.evidence: Payments method status was intentionally not inspected because payout method details are private and are not required to prove ad serving.
items.ownerAction: Owner must check Payments settings and record only whether the payout method is eligible or still needs owner action.

items.evidence: Payments hold status was intentionally not inspected because the page may expose private payment and compliance details.
items.ownerAction: Owner must check whether any payment hold, self-hold, compliance hold, identity hold, or tax hold is present and record only the public-safe status.

items.evidence: Google Play declarations were reviewed: Ads=Yes, Advertising ID=Yes, Data safety includes Google Mobile Ads SDK data, and privacy policy URL matches listing. Disclosures include IP address, user product interactions, diagnostics, and device or other identifiers; Advertising ID matches the release manifest.
items.ownerAction: Owner must verify Play Console App content declarations for Ads, Advertising ID, and Data safety match the release artifact and privacy policy before production monetization claims.

items.evidence: Release-equivalent Android Habits banner serving remains unverified until version 39 is accepted by Play, installed from Play, and a real request and impression are observed after consent.
items.ownerAction: Install the exact production artifact, complete consent, verify the Habits banner and protected-surface removal, then confirm a real AdMob request and impression without using production live ads on a development emulator.
